article.story: BETHLEHEM, Pa. -- — Jeremiah Quigley had 22 points, seven assists, six rebounds and five steals as Binghamton beat Lehigh 90-83 on Tuesday night. Kijan Robinson scored 19 points for the Bearcats (5-3), shooting 6 for 9 (4 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line. Dylan Godfrey had 15 points and went 6 of 8 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range). Hank Alvey led the Mountain Hawks (4-3) in scoring, finishing with 16 points and two steals. Lehigh also got 16 points and four assists from Chris Tshibola. Joshua Ingram also had 15 points and five assists. Binghamton took the lead almost 8 minutes into the game and did not trail again. Robinson led the Bearcats with 11 points in the first half to help put them ahead 42-34 at the break. Binghamton was outscored by Lehigh in the second half by a one-point margin, but still wound up on top, while Quigley led the way with a team-high 12 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
